name: TB OTD - Order Events Streaming
description: Streams orders-v1 / inventory-v1 / shipments-v1 from Pub/Sub into BigQuery otd.* with validation, store enrichment, 1-minute store metrics and a dead-letter path to events-dlq.

parameters.name: deadLetterTopic
parameters.label: Dead-letter topic
parameters.helpText: Pub/Sub topic receiving invalid messages and rejected BigQuery rows, e.g. projects/my-project/topics/events-dlq

parameters.name: bigQueryDataset
parameters.label: BigQuery dataset
parameters.helpText: Dataset holding order_events, order_lines, inventory_events, shipment_events, store_order_metrics and dead_letter (default otd)

parameters.name: bigQueryProject
parameters.label: BigQuery project
parameters.helpText: Project of the dataset; defaults to the job's project

parameters.name: metricsAllowedLatenessMinutes
parameters.label: Metrics allowed lateness (minutes)
parameters.helpText: How long after the watermark passes a window late events still update it (default 5)

parameters.name: storeReferenceGcsPath
parameters.label: Store reference CSV
parameters.helpText: Optional gs:// path of a CSV store_id,store_name,region,timezone used to enrich order rows

parameters.name: bigQueryTriggeringSeconds
parameters.label: BigQuery flush interval (seconds)
parameters.helpText: Storage Write API triggering frequency in exactly-once mode (default 10)

parameters.name: useStorageApiAtLeastOnce
parameters.label: Use at-least-once Storage Write API
parameters.helpText: true = STORAGE_API_AT_LEAST_ONCE (no shuffle, lower latency, possible duplicates); false = exactly-once STORAGE_WRITE_API (default)
